lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 13 distinct high-contrast white vertical line segments traversing the torso. Spacing is non-uniform, with wider intervals of approximately 40-50 pixels on the anterior flank and narrower intervals of approximately 20 pixels towards the posterior lumbar region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped bifurcation observed on the 4th line from the anterior, splitting downward at the torso's vertical midpoint. A merging topology is visible on the 11th line near the dorsal ridge intersection.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Five abbreviated line segments identified: one short vertical mark on the shoulder, two dashed segments between the 6th and 7th primary lines, and two mid-flank terminations before reaching the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: High-density cluster of approximately 9 distinct white spots positioned on the posterior haunch and upper hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Horizontal alignment of 4 distinct spots forming a semi-connected geometric line across the lateral mid-thigh.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white transverse band across the bridge of the muzzle. Distinct white supraorbital spot. White pelage visible on the lower interior ear margins.
